metadata.name: bordrless_companion
metadata.description: Bordrless companions: a launch's creator is a program, so its creator fees are bought back and burned, streamed to holders or vested to its launcher by code, every step permissionless. Reward and buyback tokens with no keeper and no backend to trust.

instructions.name: allow_wallet_payouts
docs: Before the launch, whoever holds the mint lets the script pay any wallet SOL (wallet
answers), within its payout terms (2026-10-13). Without it, a script pays holders only.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The launch's mint, the keypair that made the companion: only its holder allows it.

instructions.name: approve
docs: The protocol's upgrade authority or the script approver (`SCRIPT_APPROVER`): approves
`program`'s code (its hash recomputed here) as a
token hook (kind 0) or a companion script (kind 1), `author` its author (a script's earns
half the creator fees of the companions made with it). Only a program nobody but Bordrless
can change (immutable, Bordrless's keys, or a hook timelock); an upgrade voids it.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The companion program's upgrade authority (the protocol's) or the script approver; pays the
rent the first time.

accounts.name: target
docs: being an upgradeable-loader program naming `target_programdata`).

instructions.name: attest
docs: Studio's attester: attests a program's code (rebuilt from its source, the hash matched with
the chain, the checks, the simulator and the review passed).

accounts.name: attester
docs: Studio's attester; pays the rent the first time.

instructions.name: burn_stranded
docs: Anyone: burns as SOL a blocked game hook's buyback that no buyback has spent or waited on
for 30 days (the pot with it), paying nobody.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Whoever sends it (paid nothing).

instructions.name: buyback
docs: Anyone: buys the token back with the pending buyback (capped, spaced) and burns it.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Whoever sends it; paid the bounty.

instructions.name: claim_fees
docs: Anyone: claims the creator fees and splits them.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Whoever sends it; paid the bounty.

instructions.name: claim_prize
docs: Anyone: pays the draw's winner for attempt `attempt`, during its window.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Whoever sends it; paid the bounty.

accounts.name: holding
docs: of this mint, at its owner's address.

instructions.name: claim_share
docs: Anyone, for any holding: pays its owner its share of streak epoch `epoch`, once.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Whoever sends it: pays the receipt's rent (returned by `close_receipt`) and is paid the
bounty.

accounts.name: holding
docs: discriminator), of this mint, at the owner's address.

accounts.name: receipt
docs: The epoch's receipt for the owner: made here, so a second claim fails.

instructions.name: close_epoch
docs: Anyone: once streak epoch `epoch` is over, fixes its pot and total and opens its claims.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Whoever sends it; paid the bounty.

instructions.name: close_receipt
docs: Anyone: once a receipt's epoch's claims have ended, returns its rent to whoever paid it.

accounts.name: receipt
docs: The receipt, closed: its rent goes back to whoever paid it.

instructions.name: create
docs: Makes a companion for `mint` (not created yet): the split, the bounty, the buyback limits,
the vesting; funds its creator address and creates its bridged-SOL holding.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The launch's mint, a fresh keypair: it signs here, so only whoever holds it can make its
companion (nobody can make one first and become its beneficiary), and the launch later.

instructions.name: create_game
docs: Makes the companion's game for `mint` (not launched yet; the mint signs): the pot's part of
the split, the hook (prepared for the mint), the rounds, the minimum pot, the prize, the
claim windows.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The launch's mint (not created yet): it signs, as for `create`, so only whoever holds it
makes its game.

accounts.name: hook_state
docs: `PDA(["state", mint], hook)`, magic, mint).

accounts.name: hook_registry
docs: `PDA(["bordrless-hook-accounts", mint], hook)`): the extra accounts a launch carries.

accounts.name: hook_status
docs: must exist, and not block the hook, for any hook but Bordrless's lottery hook.

instructions.name: create_game_v2
docs: Makes the companion's game of any kind (`create_game`'s arguments, and the kind's own
settings): a lottery, a last-buyer jackpot or a holding streak.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The launch's mint (not created yet): it signs, as for `create`, so only whoever holds it
makes its game.

accounts.name: hook_state
docs: `PDA(["state", mint], hook)`, magic, mint).

accounts.name: hook_registry
docs: `PDA(["bordrless-hook-accounts", mint], hook)`): the extra accounts a launch carries.

accounts.name: hook_status
docs: must exist, and not block the hook, for any hook but Bordrless's lottery hook.

instructions.name: create_script
docs: Before the launch, the mint signing: the companion becomes a script companion, its pot's part
of every fee claim spent by a builder's program (the script: approved by Bordrless, or
immutable), whose
`companion_init` runs here. The remaining accounts are forwarded to it.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the rent of the script account and of the script's state; never passed to the script.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The launch's mint, not created yet: it signs, so only whoever made the companion makes its
script.

accounts.name: script_state
docs: the script, when `state_len` is above 0; unused otherwise.

accounts.name: approval
docs: for an immutable script).

instructions.name: create_script_v2
docs: `create_script` with payout terms (Loss cover, 2026-10-12): the bounds the script's payouts
keep within, kept at `PDA(["payout-terms", mint])`, the payer paying its rent.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the rent of the script account, of the script's state and of the terms; never passed
to the script.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The launch's mint, not created yet: it signs.

accounts.name: terms
docs: The payout terms, `PDA(["payout-terms", mint])`, made here.

instructions.name: create_snowball
docs: Snowball (2026-10-12): before the launch, the mint signing, the companion becomes a market
maker: the pot's part of every fee claim, the step, the trade sizes, the interval and the cap.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The launch's mint, not created yet: it signs, so only whoever made the companion makes its
Snowball.

instructions.name: create_strategy_game
docs: Makes the companion's strategy game for `mint` (not launched yet; the mint signs): the game's
arguments (kind `Strategy`, a lottery hook's tickets) and the strategy's terms.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The launch's mint (not created yet): it signs, as for `create`.

instructions.name: dev_buy
docs: The beneficiary's buy, held by the companion and vesting to them.

instructions.name: draw
docs: Anyone: once `round` is over, commits its draw's seed, made from `slot` (one of the last
three slots), and asks the oracle for it, the pot paying (or adopts a pending request for
it), in one instruction; or rolls the round over: no tickets, too late, or the pot unable to
pay for the oracle's request.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Whoever sends it; paid the bounty.

instructions.name: expire
docs: Anyone: rolls over a draw that can't go on (nobody won it, or its claims ended).

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Whoever sends it; paid the bounty.

instructions.name: launch
docs: Creates the launch through the launchpad, the creator address signing as its creator. The
remaining accounts are `create_launch`'s.

instructions.name: migrate_companion_to_native
docs: The upgrade authority, with the DEX paused, the companion's launch native: turns the
companion native (its SOL to its creator address's lamports). Idempotent.

accounts.name: admin
docs: The companion program's upgrade authority; pays a byte's rent when the companion grows.

instructions.name: pay_strategy
docs: Anyone, for up to `max_per_tx` holdings: asks the strategy what each gets of the open
period's budget and pays it, once a holding.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Whoever sends it: pays the receipts' rent (returned by `close_receipt`) and is paid the
bounties.

instructions.name: plan_period
docs: Anyone: once strategy period `period` is over, asks the strategy for its budget and opens
its payments (or closes it with nothing).

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Whoever sends it (paid nothing).

instructions.name: release
docs: Anyone: sends the beneficiary the dev bag's vested tokens.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Whoever sends it; paid the bounty.

instructions.name: retire
docs: Anyone: sends the pot of a game that has paid no prize for two dormant periods to the
buyback, paying nobody.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Whoever sends it; paid the bounty.

instructions.name: reveal
docs: Anyone: stores the oracle's answer; the claim windows start.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Whoever sends it; paid the bounty.

instructions.name: revert_companion_to_bridged
docs: The upgrade authority, with the DEX paused: turns a native companion back to bridged SOL.
Idempotent.

accounts.name: admin
docs: The companion program's upgrade authority; pays a byte's rent when the companion grows.

instructions.name: revoke
docs: The attester or the protocol's upgrade authority: revokes an attestation.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Studio's attester, or the companion's upgrade authority.

instructions.name: revoke_approval
docs: The protocol's upgrade authority or the script approver: revokes `program`'s approval.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The companion program's upgrade authority, or the script approver.

accounts.name: approval
docs: The approval of the instruction's `program` (checked in the handler).

instructions.name: script_step
docs: Anyone, once an interval: the script's `companion_step`, the creator address signing, then
the companion's checks (the pot spent and nothing else, the dev bag and the lamports kept,
custody unchanged); pays a bounty from the pot. The remaining accounts are forwarded to it.
A script may answer payouts in its return data (Loss cover, 2026-10-12): each entry is
checked against the script's payout terms, paid to the holding's owner as SOL and recorded
by the launch's hook (`record_payout`).

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Whoever sends it; paid the bounty. Its signature is never forwarded to the script.

accounts.name: script_state
docs: when it has one (`Script.state_len` above 0).

accounts.name: approval
docs: not read for an immutable script).

instructions.name: set_hook_status
docs: The protocol's upgrade authority: whether a game hook is audited, its pots' cap while not,
and whether it is blocked.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The companion program's upgrade authority (the protocol's), paying the rent the first time.

accounts.name: hook_status
docs: What the protocol says of `hook`, made the first time.

instructions.name: set_hook_status_v2
docs: The protocol's upgrade authority: `set_hook_status`, with an audit tied to the code's hash
(only of an immutable or Bordrless-managed program; the hash recomputed and kept).

accounts.name: authority
docs: The companion program's upgrade authority (the protocol's), paying the rent the first time.

accounts.name: hook_status
docs: What the protocol says of `hook`, made the first time.

instructions.name: set_payees
docs: Up to 10 wallets that share the beneficiary part, each a fixed share of it, set once before
the launch by whoever holds the mint (2026-10-13): every `withdraw` pays them their parts as
SOL, the beneficiary the rest.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The launch's mint, the keypair that made the companion: only its holder sets payees.

instructions.name: settle
docs: Anyone: closes the oldest jackpot round that is over, paying its last qualifying buyer if
they still hold what they bought, else forfeiting it.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Whoever sends it; paid the bounty.

accounts.name: holding
docs: of this mint, at its owner's address.

instructions.name: share
docs: Anyone: streams the holders' part to holders through the kit.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Whoever sends it; paid the bounty.

instructions.name: snowball_step
docs: Anyone: a Snowball's trade on its pool, a buy on a dip or a sell on a rise of its step from
the reference (or a follow of the price when that side has nothing to trade); pays a bounty.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Whoever sends it; paid the bounty on a trade.

instructions.name: withdraw
docs: Anyone: pays the beneficiary their part as SOL.

errors.name: BadSplit

errors.name: BountyTooHigh
errors.msg: the bounty is at most 1% of what a step moves

errors.name: BadBuybackLimits
errors.msg: buybacks need a cap above zero and at least a minute between them

errors.name: VestTooLong
errors.msg: a dev bag vests over a year at most

errors.name: MissingAccount
errors.msg: an account the step needs was not passed

errors.name: WrongCreator
errors.msg: the launch's creator must be this companion's creator address

errors.name: WrongMint
errors.msg: the launch's mint must be this companion's mint

errors.name: AlreadyLaunched
errors.msg: this companion has launched already

errors.name: NotLaunched
errors.msg: this companion has not launched yet

errors.name: CreatorLockUnsupported
errors.msg: a companion launch can't use the creator wallet lock: the companion's own vesting replaces it

errors.name: HolderRewardsOff
errors.msg: a share for holders needs holder rewards on

errors.name: CustomHookUnsupported
errors.msg: a companion launch can't use a custom token hook unless it runs that hook's game

errors.name: NothingToDo
errors.msg: nothing to do yet

errors.name: BuybackNotDue

errors.name: MathOverflow

errors.name: Underfunded

errors.name: AuthorShareUnsupported

errors.name: BeneficiaryNotAWallet
errors.msg: with holder rewards on, the beneficiary must be a wallet (the dev bag can only go to one)

errors.name: DevBuyWindowClosed

errors.name: DevBagOverMaxWallet
errors.msg: the dev bag would hold more than max wallet allows a wallet before graduation

errors.name: EarlyLocked
errors.msg: tokens bought in the early-buyer window stay until it unlocks

errors.name: NoQuote
errors.msg: the pool can't quote a buyback right now

errors.name: OracleAccount
errors.msg: an account of the randomness oracle is not the one expected

errors.name: OracleFeeTooHigh
errors.msg: the randomness oracle's fee is above the most a draw pays

errors.name: OracleNotFulfilled
errors.msg: the randomness oracle has not answered yet

errors.name: OracleFulfilled
errors.msg: the randomness oracle has answered: reveal the draw

errors.name: BadGame

errors.name: NotAGame

errors.name: GameHookMismatch

errors.name: HookState

errors.name: HookRegistry
errors.msg: the game hook's registry is not the one expected

errors.name: HookStatusAccount
errors.msg: the hook status account is not the one expected

errors.name: NotProtocolAuthority
errors.msg: only the protocol's upgrade authority sets a hook's status

errors.name: BadHookStatus
errors.msg: an audit is final, an audited hook can't be blocked, a blocked hook is unblocked only by an audit, and a hook not audited is capped at 0.1 to 10 SOL

errors.name: DrawPending
errors.msg: a draw is in progress

errors.name: NoDraw
errors.msg: no draw is at this step

errors.name: RoundNotOver
errors.msg: the round is not over, or has been drawn already

errors.name: PotTooSmall
errors.msg: the pot is below the game's minimum

errors.name: AttemptClosed
errors.msg: this attempt's claim window is not open

errors.name: NotTheWinner
errors.msg: this holding does not hold the drawn ticket

errors.name: NotEligible
errors.msg: this owner can't win: the launch, its pool, the creator address, or an address off the curve

errors.name: WrongHolding
errors.msg: the holding is not the one expected

errors.name: NotDue
errors.msg: too early for this step

errors.name: DrawLate
errors.msg: too late: a draw's claims end with the round after the drawn one

errors.name: TooManyHookExtras
errors.msg: a game hook's registry lists more extra accounts than a launch transaction can carry

errors.name: OracleUnanswered
errors.msg: the oracle has not answered the last request the pot paid for: the pot pays for a new one only after a backoff

errors.name: GameHookNotAccepted
errors.msg: a game's hook must be Bordrless's lottery hook, or one the protocol has given a status, and not blocked

errors.name: HookNotBlocked
errors.msg: only a blocked game hook's stranded buyback can be burned

errors.name: StaleSeed
errors.msg: a draw's seed comes from one of the last 3 slots, which ORAO has not answered: build the draw again from a newer slot

errors.name: WrongGameKind
errors.msg: this step is for another kind of game

errors.name: NoShare
errors.msg: this holding has no share of the epoch: no weight registered, below the minimum, above its balance, or forfeited by a send

errors.name: FeesUnclaimed
errors.msg: the launch holds creator fees nobody has claimed that could fund this prize: claim the fees first, in the same transaction

errors.name: NotAttester
errors.msg: only Studio's attester writes an attestation; only it or the protocol's upgrade authority revokes one

errors.name: AttestationHashMismatch
errors.msg: the attested build hash is not the hash of the program's code on chain

errors.name: BadAttestation
errors.msg: an attestation records a passing simulation and a review that passed or warned

errors.name: HookNotAttested
errors.msg: a game hook taken without a status (Studio's, the protocol's or a timelock's to upgrade) needs a current Studio attestation

errors.name: AuditNeedsFixedCode
errors.msg: only an immutable or Bordrless-managed program can be audited: finalize a timelocked one first

errors.name: AuditHashMismatch
errors.msg: the audited hash is not the hash of the program's code on chain

errors.name: ProgramAccounts
errors.msg: the program's accounts (the program, its program data, its timelock) are missing or wrong

errors.name: StrategyNotAccepted
errors.msg: a strategy must be immutable, timelocked or Bordrless-managed, not blocked, and none of the protocol's programs

errors.name: StrategyAccounts
errors.msg: a strategy's accounts are not the ones its terms name, or not the strategy's own

errors.name: StrategyRegistry
errors.msg: a strategy's registry lists at most 2 accounts, each owned by the strategy

errors.name: TooManyCandidates
errors.msg: a strategy payment takes 1 to max_per_tx candidates

errors.name: PeriodNotOpen
errors.msg: no strategy period is open for payments

errors.name: BadStrategy
errors.msg: a strategy's terms are out of bounds

errors.name: RevokedByProtocol
errors.msg: the protocol revoked this program's attestation: it can't be attested again

errors.name: TimelockPending
errors.msg: the program's timelock holds a proposal of new code: a game is made on a timelocked program only while nothing is pending (its author cancels it, or it lands first)

errors.name: BadSnowball
errors.msg: a Snowball's terms are out of bounds, or its companion is launched, a game, a script or already a Snowball

errors.name: NotASnowball
errors.msg: not a Snowball companion

errors.name: SnowballNotDue
errors.msg: no Snowball step is due: too soon, or the price is within its step of the reference

errors.name: NotApproved
errors.msg: the program has no current approval of this kind from Bordrless: none, revoked, of another kind, or its code changed since it was approved

errors.name: BadScript
errors.msg: a script's terms are out of bounds (interval, init data, split), its program is one of the protocol's, or its companion is launched, a game, a Snowball or a script already

errors.name: ScriptNotDue
errors.msg: no script step is due: too soon after the launch or the last step

errors.name: ScriptOverspent
errors.msg: the script spent more bridged SOL than the pot holds

errors.name: ScriptTookDevBag
errors.msg: the script moved tokens of the dev bag

errors.name: ScriptTookLamports
errors.msg: the script took lamports from the creator address

errors.name: BadApproval
errors.msg: an approval is of a token hook (0) or a script (1), a script is none of the protocol's programs, and the hash must be the program's code on chain

errors.name: NotAScript
errors.msg: not a script companion

errors.name: ScriptBrokeCustody
errors.msg: the script delegated or closed one of the creator's holdings, changed the creator address's owner or data, or claimed the creator fees

errors.name: ProgramNotBounded
errors.msg: an approved program must be one only Bordrless can change: immutable, upgradeable only by Bordrless's keys, or behind a hook timelock (passed)

errors.name: PayoutsOff
errors.msg: this script companion has no payout terms: a script made with create_script pays nobody

errors.name: PayoutsNeedHook
errors.msg: payouts need a custom hook that writes hook data, which records each one

errors.name: BadPayoutAnswer
errors.msg: the script's answer does not decode as a payout answer: its version, its length, more than 16 entries, an index past the accounts, an account that is no holding of the mint, or a holding named twice

errors.name: PayoutTarget
errors.msg: a payout can only go to a wallet holding the token: not the launch, its pool, the creator address, a program's account, an account left out or read-only, or one left below its rent-exempt minimum

errors.name: PayoutToBeneficiary
errors.msg: the launcher's own holding is never paid by a script

errors.name: PayoutOverBound
errors.msg: a payout is over the terms: the holding's cap, the step's budget, or the window's

errors.name: BadPayoutTerms
errors.msg: payout terms are 1 to 10,000 basis points each and a window of 10 seconds to a day

errors.name: BadPayees
errors.msg: payees are 1 to 10 distinct wallets, each 1 to 10,000 basis points of the beneficiary part and 10,000 in all at most, none of them the beneficiary, the creator address or the companion, set once before the launch

errors.name: PayeesMissing
errors.msg: this companion shares its beneficiary part: pass its payees account (writable) and each payee

errors.name: WalletPayoutTarget
errors.msg: a wallet payout goes to an account passed writable that can take SOL and keeps its rent-exempt minimum: no account of a Bordrless program, the launch's, the pool's, the creator address, the companion, the script's or the hook's, named once

errors.name: WalletPayoutsOff
errors.msg: this script may not pay wallets: its launcher did not allow wallet payouts before the launch (allow_wallet_payouts)

errors.name: DexNotPaused
errors.msg: the DEX must be paused for this

errors.name: LaunchNotNative
errors.msg: the companion's launch is not native yet: migrate the launch (and its pool) first

errors.name: ScriptNotNativeReady
errors.msg: this script is not native-ready: it can't launch while native launches are on

types.name: AnswerFault
docs: Why a strategy's answer was refused (never clamped).

types.name: Approval
docs: Bordrless's approval of a program's code (2026-10-12), `PDA(["approval", program])`, written only
by the companion program's upgrade authority or the script approver (`SCRIPT_APPROVER`;
`approve`, `revoke_approval`). It is bound to the
code: `approve` hashes the program's code on chain and refuses any other hash, and an approval
counts only while the program still runs that code (`approval::approved`: the ProgramData's slot
unchanged since, or the code hashed again). Upgrading an approved program voids its approval
until it is approved again. Only a program nobody but Bordrless can change is approved:
immutable, upgradeable only by Bordrless's keys, or behind a hook timelock.

fields.name: kind
docs: `APPROVAL_KIND_TOKEN_HOOK` (0) or `APPROVAL_KIND_SCRIPT` (1).

fields.name: code_hash
docs: `solana-verify`'s executable hash of the approved code.

fields.name: updated_by
docs: Who last wrote it (the upgrade authority or the script approver that approved or revoked
it).

fields.name: programdata_slot
docs: The program's ProgramData slot when approved: while it is unchanged the code is the approved
code (the loader refuses a second deploy, upgrade or extension in one slot), so a check needs
no hash; once it moved (an upgrade, or anyone's `ExtendProgram`) the code is hashed again.

fields.name: author
docs: Who wrote the program: a script's author earns `AUTHOR_SHARE_BPS` of the creator fees of
every script companion made with it afterwards (`create_script` copies it into the `Script`).
The default key: no author. (From what was `reserved`.)

types.name: ApprovalRevoked
docs: Bordrless revoked a program's approval (`revoke_approval`).

types.name: AttestArgs
docs: Arguments of `attest`.

fields.name: build_hash
docs: `solana-verify`'s executable hash of the code Studio built: must be the code on chain.

fields.name: sim_pass
docs: Must be true: a failing simulation gets no attestation.

fields.name: review
docs: `REVIEW_PASS` or `REVIEW_WARN`.

fields.name: kind
docs: 0 a token hook, 1 a game hook, 2 a strategy.

types.name: AttestationRevoked
docs: An attestation revoked (by the attester or the protocol's upgrade authority).

types.name: AuthorPaid
docs: A script companion's fee claim paid the script's author their share (`AUTHOR_SHARE_BPS` of what
the claim took from the launch), as SOL, before the split.

types.name: BuybackWaited
docs: A buyback that waited: the price was above the reference (which moved toward it, when due).

types.name: CandidateReason
docs: Why a candidate of `pay_strategy` was not paid (the others go on).

types.name: CandidateRejected
docs: A candidate of `pay_strategy` not paid: no receipt, nothing moved.

fields.name: answered
docs: What the strategy answered, when it was over its bound or too little for an empty wallet.

types.name: Companion
docs: `PDA(["companion", mint])`.

fields.name: creator_bump
docs: Bump of `PDA(["creator", mint])`, the launch's creator.

fields.name: beneficiary
docs: Who launched it: receives the beneficiary's part of the fees and the vested dev bag.

fields.name: bounty_bps
docs: What a step pays whoever sends it, of what it moves (at most `MAX_BOUNTY_BPS`).

fields.name: max_buyback
docs: The most one buyback spends (lamports of bridged SOL).

fields.name: buyback_interval
docs: The least time between buybacks.

fields.name: vest_secs
docs: The dev bag vests linearly over this many seconds from the launch (0: at once).

fields.name: dev_tokens
docs: Tokens bought for the dev bag, and released to the beneficiary so far.

fields.name: pending_buyback
docs: Bridged SOL held for each purpose (in the creator's holding).

fields.name: claimed_total
docs: Running totals.

fields.name: reference_price
docs: The buyback's reference price (quote per base unit times `PRICE_SCALE`), set at the launch and
moved toward the pool's price by at most `REFERENCE_STEP_BPS` at a time, once an interval.

fields.name: game_hook
docs: The game's token hook (`create_game`); the default key for a companion without a game.

fields.name: pot_bps
docs: The pot's part of every fee claim, next to `split` (the four sum to 10,000).

fields.name: pending_pot
docs: Bridged SOL held for the game's pot (in the creator's holding).

fields.name: round_secs
docs: The game's round length, which its hook's header must state (checked at the launch).

fields.name: stranded_burned_at
docs: When `burn_stranded` last burned a blocked game's buyback, a blocked game's pot last moved
into the buyback (by any step: `enforce_terms`), or a blocked game's fee claim last credited
the buyback at least what it held (`Companion::restart_stranded_wait`) (0: never): the
next burn waits its whole period from here, so a pot moved, or a share credited to a
buyback that had spent what it was given, is never burned before keepers have had that
long to spend it.

fields.name: game_kind
docs: The game's kind (`create_game`), which the launch checks the hook's flags and header by.

fields.name: pot_locked
docs: The part of `pending_pot` a closed streak epoch still owes its holders: a cap lowered since
never trims it (`steps::enforce_terms`), and only a block moves it to the buyback. Zero for
every other kind.

fields.name: mode
docs: `MODE_CLASSIC`, `MODE_SNOWBALL` or `MODE_SCRIPT` (2026-10-12), the last byte of what was
`reserved`: zero, classic, in every companion made before.

fields.name: quote_cut_claimed
docs: How much of the launch's `quote_cut_accrued` (the hook's SOL cut, paid into the creator fee
vault with the creator fee) this companion's fee claims have taken: what a claim takes
beyond it, up to the whole claim, is the hook's and goes to the pot's bucket.

fields.name: native_sol
docs: Whether the companion's SOL is lamports on its creator address (`crate::instructions::native`)
rather than bridged SOL in the creator's holding.

types.name: CompanionNativeSet
docs: A companion moved between bridged SOL (its creator's holding) and native SOL (its creator
address's lamports): `moved` the SOL that changed form, `spare` the creator address's spare
lamports booked to the beneficiary's part when it turned native.

types.name: CreateArgs
docs: Arguments of `create`.

fields.name: max_buyback
docs: The most one buyback spends, lamports (ignored without a buyback share).

fields.name: buyback_interval
docs: The least time between buybacks, seconds.

fields.name: vest_secs
docs: The dev bag vests over this many seconds from the launch.

fields.name: fund
docs: Lamports for the creator address: the launch's fee and rent (it pays them as the launch's
creator) and its own rent-exempt minimum, which it keeps.

types.name: CreateGameArgs
docs: Arguments of `create_game`.

fields.name: hook
docs: The coin's token hook (game ticket standard v1), already prepared for the mint with
`round_secs`; the launch's config must name it.

fields.name: split
docs: Every fee claim's split, with the pot's part: the four sum to 10,000. No holders' part: a
game coin has its own hook, so no kit.

fields.name: round_secs
docs: As the hook's header says: a lottery's rounds 5 minutes to 30 days, a streak's epochs an
hour to 30 days.

fields.name: min_pot
docs: No draw while the pot holds less (0.1 to 1,000 SOL).

fields.name: prize_bps
docs: The part of the pot one draw pays (10% to 100%).

fields.name: claim_window_secs
docs: How long each claim attempt is open (a minute to a day; a streak's least time for claims,
5 minutes to half an epoch).

fields.name: max_attempts
docs: Attempts per draw (1 to 16); all of them within half a round (`max_attempts *
claim_window_secs <= round_secs / 2`), so a draw made early in the round after its own
keeps every attempt before its claims end.

types.name: CreateLaunchArgs
docs: Arguments of `create_launch`.

fields.name: name
docs: Name.

fields.name: symbol
docs: Symbol.

fields.name: uri
docs: Metadata URI.

fields.name: creator_fee_bps
docs: Creator fee in basis points of the quote, at most the config's maximum. With a
`LaunchConfig` it must equal the config's.

fields.name: virtual_quote
docs: Virtual quote reserve the curve opens with (sets the opening market cap), within the
config's bounds.

fields.name: rules
docs: The token rules, within the config's bounds; fixed at launch. With a `LaunchConfig` they
must equal the config's.

types.name: CreateScriptArgs
docs: Arguments of `create_script`.

fields.name: split
docs: Every fee claim's split besides the pot: the four parts (with `pot_bps`) sum to 10,000.

fields.name: pot_bps
docs: The pot's part of every fee claim: what the script spends.

fields.name: program
docs: The script: a program with a current approval of kind `APPROVAL_KIND_SCRIPT`, or an immutable
one, which needs none.

fields.name: interval
docs: The least time between steps (10 seconds to a day).

fields.name: state_len
docs: The size of the script's state the companion makes (0: none; at most
`MAX_SCRIPT_STATE_LEN`).

fields.name: init_data
docs: Handed to the script's `companion_init` (at most `MAX_SCRIPT_INIT_LEN` bytes).

types.name: CreateSnowballArgs
docs: Arguments of `create_snowball`.

fields.name: split
docs: Every fee claim's split besides the pot: the four parts (with `pot_bps`) sum to 10,000.

fields.name: pot_bps
docs: The pot's part of every fee claim: what the market maker trades with.

fields.name: buy_step_bps
docs: The drop from the reference that triggers a buy, and the rise that triggers a sell (0.5% to
20% each).

fields.name: buy_bps
docs: The share of the pot a buy spends, and of its tokens a sell sells (1% to 100% each).

fields.name: interval
docs: The least time between trades (10 seconds to a day).

fields.name: max_trade
docs: The most one trade moves, lamports (at least 0.01 SOL).

fields.name: pool_bps
docs: The most one trade moves as a share of the pool's SOL side (0.25% to 10%).

fields.name: flat_trades
docs: Trade every interval even when the price is within its steps (on the side that rebalances).

types.name: DrawCommitted
docs: A draw committed its seed, made from the hash of one of the last `oracle::SEED_SLOTS` slots, so
nobody could know its answer: always with its request (`DrawRequested`, the same instruction).

fields.name: total
docs: The round's ticket total, read from the hook's header.

fields.name: n
docs: The seed's index in the round.

fields.name: request
docs: The oracle's request account for the seed.

fields.name: slot
docs: The slot whose hash is in the seed (the draw named it).

types.name: DrawRequested
docs: A draw's seed requested from the oracle, in the instruction that committed it (or a pending
request someone had already made for it adopted: then nothing is paid).

fields.name: n
docs: The seed's index in the round.

fields.name: request
docs: The oracle's request account, where the randomness will be.

fields.name: made
docs: Whether the companion made the request (else it adopted one ORAO already held).

fields.name: fee
docs: The oracle's fee, and what the pot sent the oracle payer for this request.

fields.name: paid_streak
docs: Requests the pot has paid for since ORAO last answered one of this game's, this one
included (`Game.paid_streak`): above 1, the last one was still unanswered.

fields.name: prize
docs: What the draw will pay.

types.name: DrawRevealed
docs: The oracle answered: the draw's randomness, from which every attempt's ticket follows.

types.name: DrawStatus
docs: Where a game's draw is.

types.name: EpochClosed
docs: A streak epoch closed: its pot and total fixed, its claims open until `claims_end`.

fields.name: total
docs: The epoch's weight total (the hook's header).

fields.name: epoch_pot
docs: What its holders share (locked for them until `claims_end`).

types.name: EpochEnded
docs: A streak epoch's claims ended: what it did not pay rolls over in the pot.

fields.name: from_hook
docs: Of `claimed` less the bounty, the part that came from the launch's hook SOL cut, credited
whole to the pot's bucket and already counted in that bucket's figure: the pot (`PotFunded`
follows for a game's, a Snowball's or a script's), else `to_buyback`, else `to_holders`
(`to_beneficiary` only for a split of the beneficiary alone). Appended 2026-10-15: absent
from events before (read it as 0).

types.name: ForfeitReason
docs: Why a jackpot round was forfeited.

types.name: Game
docs: `PDA(["game", mint])`: a companion's game (`create_game`), its settings fixed before the launch,
and its draw. The pot itself is `Companion.pending_pot` (bridged SOL in the creator's holding).

fields.name: hook
docs: The coin's token hook, which keeps the tickets (game ticket standard v1).

fields.name: state_bump
docs: Bumps of the hook's `["state", mint]`, of `["hook-status", hook]` and of `["oracle", mint]`.

fields.name: round_secs
docs: Rounds are `floor(unix_time / round_secs)`, as the hook's header says.

fields.name: min_pot
docs: No draw while the pot holds less.

fields.name: prize_bps
docs: The part of the pot one draw pays.

fields.name: claim_window_secs
docs: How long each attempt's claim is open.

fields.name: max_attempts
docs: Attempts per draw before the round rolls over.

fields.name: next_round
docs: The earliest round the next draw may be for (every earlier one is drawn or rolled over).

fields.name: round
docs: The round of the current (or last) draw, and its ticket total, read from the hook's header.

fields.name: n
docs: The seed's index in the round, part of its derivation: always 0. A round has one seed,
which is final (never replaced while the draw lasts, however late ORAO answers).

fields.name: seed
docs: The draw's seed and the oracle's request account for it (`oracle::request_address(seed)`),
committed and requested together, by `draw`, at `committed_at` (`requested_at`, the same).

fields.name: randomness
docs: The revealed randomness, and when.

fields.name: prize
docs: What this draw pays (fixed at the request: `prize_bps` of the pot then).

fields.name: oracle_total
docs: Lamports the pot has sent the oracle payer.

fields.name: settled_at
docs: When the pot last paid a prize or was retired to the buyback (0: never, and the launch
counts): a pot that pays nothing for long is dormant (`Game::dormant_secs`), then
retirable (`Game::retirable_at`).

fields.name: paid_seed
docs: The seed of the last request the pot paid for, until a draw is revealed (zeros: none). While
ORAO has not answered it (still pending, in a form this program can't read, or gone), the
pot pays for no new request until `Game::oracle_backoff_rounds` rounds after its draw's.

fields.name: paid_round
docs: The round of that request's draw.

fields.name: paid_streak
docs: Requests the pot has paid for since ORAO last answered one of this game's (a reveal, or
the last paid request found answered).

fields.name: timer_secs
docs: A round ends this long after its last qualifying buy (as the hook's jackpot header says).

fields.name: min_tokens
docs: The least a qualifying buy delivers (as the hook says; its holding must still hold the
round's amount).

fields.name: paid_buys
docs: The last round settled (paid or forfeited), by number: only later rounds can be.

fields.name: min_streak_secs
docs: A holding shares in an epoch only if, by its end, it has sent nothing for this long.

fields.name: min_weight
docs: The least weight that shares.

fields.name: epoch_paid
docs: What the claim epoch's pot has paid so far (bounties included).

fields.name: hook_audit_slot
docs: The deploy slot of the game hook's code when its audit last held for it (`hook_audit_ok`):
an audit the protocol recorded with the code's hash (`set_hook_status_v2`) lifts the cap
only while the hook is immutable or Bordrless-managed and runs that code. A step rehashes the
code only when its deploy slot moved since (an upgrade, or anyone's `ExtendProgram`).

fields.name: hook_audit_ok
docs: The hook's hashed audit held at `hook_audit_slot`.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Room for the kinds to come, zero until then.

types.name: GameCreated
docs: A game made for a companion before its launch (`create_game`): its split now includes the pot.

fields.name: first_round
docs: The first round a draw may be for.

types.name: GameKind
docs: The kinds of game a companion runs. Borsh writes the variant's index, so a kind added later is
appended and every game made before keeps its own (a companion made before phase 2 reads 0,
the lottery, in `Companion.game_kind`).

types.name: GameKindArgs
docs: Phase 2's settings of a game, beside `CreateGameArgs` (`create_game_v2`): a jackpot's timer and
minimum buy, a streak's minimum streak and weight. All zero for a lottery. Each must equal what
the hook's kind header says (the hook applies them; the companion checks them again).

fields.name: timer_secs
docs: Jackpot: a round ends this long after its last qualifying buy (5 minutes to 30 days).

fields.name: min_tokens
docs: Jackpot: the least a qualifying buy delivers, in the token's base units (at least 1).

fields.name: min_streak_secs
docs: Streak: a holding shares in an epoch only if, by its end, it has sent nothing for this long
(at most a year).

fields.name: min_weight
docs: Streak: the least weight that shares (at least 1).

types.name: GameKindSet
docs: `create_game_v2`: the game's kind settings (with `GameCreated`), and the terms its hook had
when it was made (a hook without a status is not audited: capped).

fields.name: pot_cap
docs: The pot's cap (0: none, audited).

types.name: HookAttestation
docs: Bordrless Studio's attestation of a program's code, `PDA(["attest", program])`, written only by
Studio's attester (`STUDIO_ATTESTER`) once Studio's worker has rebuilt the program's source,
matched the build's hash with the code on chain (checked again here, when written), and passed
the static checks, the simulator and the review. Revoked by the attester or the protocol's
upgrade authority. "Current" while not revoked and its `build_hash` is the program's code as it
is (`programdata_slot` unchanged is the fast check; an extension changes the slot, not the code,
so a reader then recomputes the hash).

fields.name: build_hash
docs: `solana-verify`'s executable hash of the attested code.

fields.name: source_hash
docs: sha256 of the frozen source Studio built.

fields.name: template_commit
docs: The Studio template's commit the source was built against (20 bytes of a git sha1).

fields.name: cut_max_bps
docs: The largest cut the simulator saw, and the cap Studio applies, in basis points.

fields.name: review
docs: `REVIEW_PASS` or `REVIEW_WARN`.

fields.name: kind
docs: What it is: 0 a token hook, 1 a game hook, 2 a strategy (informative).

fields.name: programdata_slot
docs: The ProgramData's slot when attested.

types.name: HookAttested
docs: Studio's attester attested a program's code (`attest`).

types.name: HookAuditRecorded
docs: `set_hook_status_v2`: the status, with the audited code's hash (zeros when not audited).

types.name: HookStatus
docs: What the protocol says of a game hook, `PDA(["hook-status", hook])`, written only by the
companion program's upgrade authority (`set_hook_status`). Without one, a hook is not audited,
its pots are capped at `DEFAULT_POT_CAP` and it is not blocked.

fields.name: audited
docs: Audited with the companion: its pots are not capped (and it is never blocked).

fields.name: pot_cap
docs: The most each pot of this hook's games holds while it is not audited.

fields.name: blocked
docs: The pot share of every game of this hook, and every pot, go to the buyback: no prize is
paid. Only for a hook that is not audited; an audit clears it.

types.name: HookStatusArgs
docs: Arguments of `set_hook_status`.

fields.name: audited
docs: Audited with the companion: its games' pots are not capped. Clears a block. Final: an
audited hook stays audited (so it can never be blocked).

fields.name: pot_cap
docs: The most each of its games' pots holds while it is not audited: `MIN_POT_CAP` (0.1 SOL)
to `DEFAULT_POT_CAP` (10 SOL). Not read once audited.

fields.name: blocked
docs: Its games' pot share and pots go to the buyback, and no prize is paid. Only for a hook
that is not audited.

types.name: HookStatusSet
docs: The protocol set what it says of a game hook.

types.name: JackpotForfeited
docs: A jackpot round closed unpaid: its buyer no longer held what they bought (or sent anything
since), can't be paid, or the round was left unsettled too long. The pot stays.

types.name: JackpotPaid
docs: A jackpot round paid its last qualifying buyer.

fields.name: round
docs: The round's number (the count of qualifying buys at its last one).

fields.name: amount
docs: What they bought, and when.

fields.name: prize
docs: Paid to the winner as SOL, and to the sender.

types.name: JackpotUnfunded
docs: A jackpot round closed paying nothing: its buyer held, but the pot was below its minimum when it
was settled (or an empty wallet could not have taken so small a prize). The pot stays.

types.name: Launch
docs: A launch at `["launch", mint]`.

fields.name: version
docs: Layout version.

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump.

fields.name: mint
docs: The token.

fields.name: creator
docs: Who launched it.

fields.name: pool
docs: The pool on the DEX.

fields.name: quote_mint
docs: The quote mint.

fields.name: status
docs: `STATUS_CURVE` or `STATUS_GRADUATED`.

fields.name: creator_fee_bps
docs: Creator fee on every swap, in basis points of the quote.

fields.name: lp_fee_bps
docs: LP fee of the pool.

fields.name: sniper_window_secs
docs: Sniper window.

fields.name: sniper_start_bps
docs: LP fee at the start of the window.

fields.name: virtual_quote
docs: Virtual quote reserve at opening.

fields.name: virtual_base
docs: Virtual base reserve.

fields.name: graduation_quote
docs: Real quote reserve at which the launch graduates.

fields.name: curve_tokens
docs: Tokens on the curve.

fields.name: reserve_tokens
docs: Tokens reserved for graduation.

fields.name: reserve_holding
docs: The launch's holding of the token (the reserve, then nothing).

fields.name: quote_holding
docs: The launch's holding of the quote (creator fees).

fields.name: lp_holding
docs: The launch's holding of the pool's LP mint (locked for ever).

fields.name: created_at
docs: Creation time.

fields.name: graduated_at
docs: Graduation time (0 until then).

fields.name: creator_fees_accrued
docs: Creator fees taken so far.

fields.name: creator_fees_claimed
docs: Creator fees claimed so far.

fields.name: graduation_topup
docs: Base added to the pool at graduation.

fields.name: graduation_burned
docs: Base burned at graduation.

fields.name: rules
docs: The token rules, fixed at launch.

fields.name: modules
docs: The kit modules of `rules` (0: no kit, no token hook).

fields.name: kit_config
docs: `PDA(["kit", mint], KIT_ID)`, derived whatever the modules (the pool hook's fixed key).

fields.name: holder_vault
docs: `holding(quote_mint, kit_config)`, derived whatever the modules: the kit's reward vault
when holder rewards are on, where holder fees go.

fields.name: kit_caller_bump
docs: Bump of `PDA(["kit-caller", mint], LAUNCH_ID)`, which signs the kit's `init` and
`graduate`; 0 without a kit.

fields.name: creator_unlock_at
docs: The creator wallet unlocks at this time; 0 when off.

fields.name: early_window_end
docs: Buys from the pool before this time are locked; 0 when off.

fields.name: early_unlock_at
docs: ... until this time; 0 when off.

fields.name: creator_bought
docs: The creator's own first buy took the normal LP fee inside the sniper window (once).

fields.name: holder_fees_accrued
docs: Holder fees taken so far (bridged SOL, into the holder vault).

fields.name: burned_on_trades
docs: Tokens burned on trades (both sides; not the graduation burn).

fields.name: config
docs: The `LaunchConfig` the launch was made from; the default key for inline rules.

fields.name: custom_hook
docs: The creator's own token hook (from the config), when the token has one. It runs on every
transfer, mint and burn its flags name; nobody vets its code.

fields.name: custom_hook_flags
docs: The custom hook's flags; 0 without one.

fields.name: author_share_bps
docs: The config author's share of the creator fee (basis points of it), from a listed config
whose author is not the launch's creator; 0 otherwise. Fixed at launch: every claim pays
the author this part of what it takes.

fields.name: author_fees_paid
docs: Creator fees paid to the config's author so far (quote).

fields.name: reserved
docs: Reserved. `reserved[0..4]` are the custom hook's SOL cut caps from the config
([`Launch::quote_cut`]), `reserved[4..12]` the SOL it has taken so far (part of
`creator_fees_accrued`), `reserved[12]` the bump of the hook's `["state", mint]` and
`reserved[13]` of the launchpad's `["quote-cut", hook]` signer; zeros for every launch made
before (`docs/quote-cut.md`). `reserved[14..16]` are the partner's share of the creator fee
and `reserved[16]` the bump of the config's [`PartnerFee`], from the config
([`Launch::partner_share_bps`], `docs/partner-fee.md`); zeros for every launch made before.

types.name: LaunchRules
docs: The rules a launch fixes for its token (`docs/hooks-v2.md` §5.1): what the pool hook takes on
each side, and the kit modules the token gets. Holder rewards are on when either holder fee is
above 0.

fields.name: holder_fee_buy_bps
docs: Holder fee on buys, from the quote input, paid to the holder vault.

fields.name: holder_fee_sell_bps
docs: Holder fee on sells, from the quote output after the protocol fee.

fields.name: burn_buy_bps
docs: Burn on buys, from the token output.

fields.name: burn_sell_bps
docs: Burn on sells, from the token input.

fields.name: max_wallet_bps
docs: Max wallet in basis points of the supply; 0 = off. Lifts at graduation.

fields.name: creator_lock_secs
docs: Creator wallet lock, counted from the launch; 0 = off.

fields.name: early_window_secs
docs: Early-buyer window, counted from the launch; 0 = off.

fields.name: early_lock_secs
docs: Early-buyer unlock, counted from the launch; above `early_window_secs` (0 when the lock is
off).

types.name: NativeSol
docs: A bool (1 byte); absent (read as false) in a companion not grown for it.

types.name: Payee
docs: One payee of a `Payees`.

fields.name: bps
docs: Its part of the beneficiary part, in basis points.

fields.name: owed
docs: Owed and not yet paid (part of the companion's `pending_beneficiary`).

fields.name: paid
docs: Paid all time.

types.name: PayeeArgs
docs: One payee of `set_payees`.

fields.name: bps
docs: Its part of the beneficiary part: 1 to 10,000 basis points.

types.name: PayeePaid
docs: A payee was paid its part of the beneficiary part, as SOL, by `withdraw`; `owed` is what it is
still owed (its account could not take a payment yet, or was not passed).

types.name: PayeeShare
docs: One payee and its share, in `PayeesSet`.

types.name: Payees
docs: The wallets that share a companion's beneficiary part (`set_payees`, 2026-10-13),
`PDA(["payees", mint])`: each gets its basis points of every `withdraw`'s beneficiary part, as
SOL; the beneficiary keeps the rest. A payee whose account can't take a payment (not passed,
read-only, or it would stay below its rent-exempt minimum) is owed it: it stays in the
companion's `pending_beneficiary` and is paid at a later `withdraw`.

fields.name: count
docs: How many of `payees` are set.

fields.name: beneficiary_owed
docs: The beneficiary's own part owed: its account could not take it (not payable, or it would
stay below its rent-exempt minimum), so it waits, as a payee's does, instead of failing
every payee's payment with it.

types.name: PayeesSet
docs: A companion's beneficiary part is shared (`set_payees`, before the launch): each payee's basis
points of it; the beneficiary keeps the rest.

types.name: PayoutTerms
docs: The bounds a script companion's payouts keep within (Loss cover, 2026-10-12),
`PDA(["payout-terms", mint])`, 128 bytes, made by `create_script_v2` with the script. A script
made with `create_script` has none, and its answers pay nobody (`PayoutsOff`). The counters are
the companion's: a step writes them after it paid.

fields.name: step_bps
docs: The most one step pays, of the pot at the step's start (1 to 10,000 basis points).

fields.name: holding_bps
docs: The most one holding gets of a step's budget (1 to 10,000).

fields.name: window_bps
docs: The most a window pays, of the pot as it stood at the window's first step (1 to 10,000).

fields.name: window_secs
docs: The window: `floor(now / window_secs)` (10 seconds to a day: a round, or a day).

fields.name: window_start
docs: The window the counters are for (its first second), the pot at its first step after the
script ran, and what it has paid.

fields.name: paid_total
docs: Lamports paid to holders all time, entries recorded all time (touches included), when.

types.name: PayoutTermsArgs
docs: The terms of `create_script_v2`: each share 1 to 10,000 basis points, the window 10 seconds to
a day.

fields.name: step_bps
docs: The most one step pays, of the pot at the step's start.

fields.name: holding_bps
docs: The most one holding gets of a step's budget.

fields.name: window_bps
docs: The most a window pays, of the pot as it stood at the window's first step.

fields.name: window_secs
docs: The window: `floor(now / window_secs)`.

types.name: PayoutTermsSet
docs: `create_script_v2`: the bounds the script's payouts keep within (`PayoutTerms`).

types.name: PeriodPlanned
docs: A strategy period planned: its budget is locked for its holders until `claims_end`.

types.name: PeriodRejected
docs: A strategy period closed with nothing: the strategy's plan was refused. The pot stays.

types.name: PeriodSkipped
docs: A strategy period whose plan answered 0: nothing is paid, the pot stays.

types.name: PotFunded
docs: A fee claim's pot share (game companions only, next to `FeesClaimed`): what the pot got, and
what went to the buyback instead (above the cap of a hook that is not audited, or all of it
for a blocked hook).

types.name: PotRetired
docs: A pot that had paid no prize for two dormant periods (`retire`) sent to the buyback: nobody is
paid it. The game goes on.

fields.name: idle_since
docs: Since when the pot had paid nothing (its last prize or retirement, or the launch).

types.name: PotToBuyback
docs: Pot money moved to the buyback: the pot of a blocked hook's game, or what a pot held above a cap
lowered since. Moved by `burn_stranded`, it waits a whole stranded period before any burn.

types.name: PrizePaid
docs: A draw paid its winner.

fields.name: prize
docs: Paid to the winner as SOL, and to the sender.

types.name: ProgramApproved
docs: Bordrless approved a program's code (`approve`): a new approval, or one rewritten.

fields.name: kind
docs: `APPROVAL_KIND_TOKEN_HOOK` (0) or `APPROVAL_KIND_SCRIPT` (1).

fields.name: programdata_slot
docs: The program's ProgramData slot at the approval.

fields.name: author
docs: The program's author (the default key: none).

types.name: QuoteCutClaimed
docs: A u64; absent (read as 0) in a companion account made before 2026-10-15.

types.name: RolledOver
docs: A round rolled over: the pot stays for the next draw (or, blocked, went to the buyback).

types.name: RolloverReason
docs: Why a round paid no prize.

types.name: Script
docs: A script companion's script (2026-10-12), `PDA(["script", mint])`, fixed at `create_script`: the
program that decides what the pot does, and how often a step may run. The pot itself is
`Companion.pending_pot` (bridged SOL in the creator's holding); what the script buys stays in the
creator's token holding beside any dev bag.

fields.name: program
docs: The script: a program Bordrless approved (`APPROVAL_KIND_SCRIPT`), called with the creator
address signing.

fields.name: interval
docs: The least time between two steps (10 seconds to a day).

fields.name: last_at
docs: When it last stepped (0: never).

fields.name: steps
docs: Steps run so far.

fields.name: author
docs: The script's author, copied from its approval at `create_script`: paid `AUTHOR_SHARE_BPS` of
what every fee claim takes from the launch, unless they are the launch's beneficiary. The
default key: no author (an approval naming nobody, or an immutable script, which needs no
approval). (From what was `reserved`.)

fields.name: author_paid
docs: What the author has been paid so far (lamports).

fields.name: state_len
docs: The size of the script's state, `PDA(["script-state", mint])`, which `create_script` made
(zeroed, owned by the script) and every call hands the script; 0: no state, the system
program's id in its place. (From what was `reserved`.)

types.name: ScriptCreated
docs: A script made for a companion (`create_script`, before the launch), its `companion_init` called.

fields.name: author
docs: The script's author, from its approval (the default key: none, as for an immutable script,
which needs no approval).

types.name: ScriptPayout
docs: One entry of a script's payout answer, paid and recorded (`script_step`): `lamports` paid to the
holding's owner as SOL (0: a touch, recorded alone), `tag` the script's, passed to the hook's
`record_payout` untouched.

fields.name: window_paid
docs: What the window has paid so far, this entry included.

fields.name: paid_total
docs: What the terms have paid all time, this entry included.

fields.name: pot_after
docs: The pot after the step (every entry and the bounty paid).

types.name: ScriptStepped
docs: A script step (`script_step`): what the creator's holdings held before and after the script ran
(bridged SOL and the token), the bounty paid from the pot, and the pot after.

fields.name: sol_before
docs: The creator's bridged SOL, lamports, before and after the script (before the bounty).

fields.name: tokens_before
docs: The creator's tokens, before and after the script.

fields.name: bounty
docs: Paid to the sender from the pot (`SCRIPT_BOUNTY`, or nothing when the pot holds less).

fields.name: pot_after
docs: The pot after the step, the bounty paid.

types.name: ScriptWalletPayout
docs: A script paid a wallet as SOL (a wallet payout, `PayoutAnswer` version 2), within its terms.

fields.name: window_paid
docs: What the window has paid so far, this entry included.

fields.name: paid_total
docs: What the terms have paid all time, this entry included.

fields.name: pot_after
docs: The pot after the step (every entry and the bounty paid).

types.name: ShareClaimed
docs: A holding's share of a streak epoch paid to its owner.

fields.name: weight
docs: Its weight, of the epoch's total.

fields.name: share
docs: Paid to the owner as SOL, and to the sender.

fields.name: epoch_paid
docs: What the epoch's pot has paid so far.

types.name: ShareReceipt
docs: `PDA(["claimed", game, epoch_le, owner])`: a streak share claimed (`claim_share`), so nobody
claims an epoch twice. Its rent is the sender's, who gets it back (`close_receipt`) once the
epoch's claims have ended.

fields.name: payer
docs: Who paid the rent, and gets it back.

fields.name: amount
docs: Paid to the owner (after the sender's bounty).

types.name: Snowball
docs: A Snowball's market maker at `PDA(["snowball", mint])` (2026-10-12): its terms, fixed at
`create_snowball`, its reference price and the tokens it holds. Its SOL is the companion's pot
(`Companion.pending_pot`, `pot_bps` of every fee claim), in the creator's bridged-SOL holding;
its tokens are in the creator's token holding beside any dev bag, counted here so a sell never
touches the dev bag.

fields.name: buy_step_bps
docs: A drop of this much from the reference price triggers a buy.

fields.name: sell_step_bps
docs: A rise of this much from the reference price triggers a sell.

fields.name: buy_bps
docs: The share of the pot a buy spends.

fields.name: sell_bps
docs: The share of the tokens it holds a sell sells.

fields.name: interval
docs: The least time between two steps that trade or follow (10 seconds to a day).

fields.name: max_trade
docs: The most one trade moves, lamports (a sell: the SOL value of what it sells).

fields.name: pool_bps
docs: The most one trade moves as a share of the pool's SOL side, real and virtual (0.25% to 10%).

fields.name: flat_trades
docs: Trade every interval even when the price is within its steps, on the side that rebalances what
it holds (the pot keeps cycling); without it, it waits for a step.

fields.name: reference_price
docs: The price the next trade is measured from (quote per base unit times `PRICE_SCALE`): the
opening price until the first step, then the price each trade left, or the price a follow
found. Zero until the first step.

fields.name: last_at
docs: When it last traded or followed.

fields.name: tokens_held
docs: Tokens it holds (bought and not sold yet).

fields.name: buys
docs: Running totals.

types.name: SnowballCreated
docs: A Snowball made for a companion (`create_snowball`, before the launch).

types.name: SnowballFollowed
docs: A Snowball that could not trade on the side the price called for (nothing left to spend or to
sell): its reference follows the price, so it stays centred on the market.

types.name: SnowballTraded
docs: A Snowball trade on the token's pool: `side` 1 a buy (on a dip), 0 a sell (on a rise).

fields.name: on_step
docs: A step triggered it (a drop or a rise); false for a flat trade.

fields.name: sol
docs: SOL spent (a buy) or received (a sell), lamports, the bounty not counted.

fields.name: tokens
docs: Tokens bought or sold.

fields.name: price_before
docs: The pool's price before and after (the new reference).

types.name: Split
docs: What every creator fee claim pays for, in basis points summing to 10,000.

fields.name: buyback_bps
docs: Bought back on the token's own pool and burned.

fields.name: holders_bps
docs: Streamed to holders through the kit's reward pool.

fields.name: beneficiary_bps
docs: Accrued to the beneficiary, who is paid it as SOL.

types.name: StrandedBurned
docs: A blocked game hook's buyback that no buy had spent for `STRANDED_SECS` (or `STRANDED_INTERVALS`
intervals) burned as SOL: unwrapped and sent to the incinerator. Nobody is paid, the sender
included. Never a pot the same call moved there: that is kept a whole wait (`PotToBuyback`).

fields.name: lamports
docs: Burned: the pending buyback (pots moved there by earlier steps included).

fields.name: since
docs: Since when no buyback had bought or waited (the latest of the launch, the last buyback,
the reference price's last move, the block, the last burn and the pot's move into the
buyback).

types.name: StrategyArgs
docs: The settings of a strategy game, beside `CreateGameArgs`.

fields.name: strategy
docs: The strategy program.

fields.name: budget_bps
docs: The most of the unlocked pot a period may pay (1 to 5,000 basis points).

fields.name: max_share_bps
docs: The most one holder gets of a period's budget (1 to 2,500 basis points).

fields.name: max_per_tx
docs: The most candidates one payment takes (1 to 4).

fields.name: plan_cu_max
docs: The most compute `plan` (to 150,000) and `entitle` (to 60,000) may use.

fields.name: min_weight
docs: The least weight that may be paid (at least 1).

types.name: StrategyPaid
docs: `pay_strategy`: the candidates paid, in one unwrap of the pot.

fields.name: bounty
docs: The sender's bounties, in all.

fields.name: epoch_paid
docs: What the period has paid so far (bounties included).

types.name: StrategyPayment
docs: One payment of a strategy period.

fields.name: amount
docs: Paid to the owner as SOL (the entitlement less the sender's bounty).

types.name: StrategySet
docs: `create_strategy_game`: a strategy game's terms (with `GameCreated`).

fields.name: class
docs: `strategy_class`.

fields.name: audited
docs: The terms then: audited only if both the ticket hook and the strategy are, the lower cap
(0: none).

types.name: StrategyTerms
docs: `PDA(["strategy", mint])`: a strategy game's terms (phase 3a, `docs/phase3a.md` §4.2), fixed at
`create_strategy_game`, beside the `Game` (whose period fields are a streak's: `round` the period
open for payments, `total` its tickets, `prize` its budget, `epoch_paid` what it has paid,
`status` `Revealed` while it is open).

fields.name: strategy
docs: The strategy program, asked `plan` and `entitle`.

fields.name: status_bump
docs: Bump of the strategy's `["hook-status", strategy]` (it need not exist).

fields.name: extras
docs: The extra accounts the strategy sees after the prefix (its registry, resolved when the game
was made), each owned by the strategy: the first `n_extras`.

fields.name: budget_bps
docs: The most of the unlocked pot a period may pay (1 to `MAX_STRATEGY_BUDGET_BPS`).

fields.name: max_share_bps
docs: The most one holder gets of a period's budget (1 to `MAX_STRATEGY_SHARE_BPS`).

fields.name: max_per_tx
docs: The most candidates a payment takes (1 to `MAX_STRATEGY_PER_TX`).

fields.name: plan_cu_max
docs: The most compute `plan` and `entitle` may use (to `MAX_PLAN_CU`, `MAX_ENTITLE_CU`).

fields.name: periods_planned
docs: Running totals.

fields.name: paid_at_active
docs: `paid_total` when the game last counted as active (`settled_at` moved): it counts again
once `STRATEGY_ACTIVE_BPS` of the pot has been paid since, over however many periods.

fields.name: audit_ok
docs: The strategy's audit, as last checked against its code: whether it held, and the deploy
slot of the code it held for (a plan recomputes the code's hash only once the slot moved).

types.name: WalletPayoutsAllowed
docs: A script companion's launcher allowed its script to pay wallets (`allow_wallet_payouts`, before
the launch).
